mostWorthwhile.text: Following the filtered fluid through recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys take useful substances and water back rather than just filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but less engaging because the named slots made the pairings predictable.

surprise.text: The filter let glucose and other useful small substances through along with wastes; I had expected filtering to be more directly about removing waste.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The pictures and named slots gave each pairing a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: tracing filtering and recovery made me curious about how another body system works, even though the organ fittings were predictable.
